sentences.en: All reinfusion sessions were well tolerated,[www.Sentencedict.com] and there was no signal of an adverse biochemical or hemodynamic reaction to therapy.

sentences.en: After the reinfusion , patients received repeated doses of interleukin 2, a potent immune system hormone that stimulates the growth of T cells.
sentences.vi: Sau khi tái truyền máu, bệnh nhân được tiêm liều lặp lại interleukin 2, một loại hormone hệ thống miễn dịch mạnh có tác dụng kích thích sự phát triển của tế bào T.

sentences.en: Before reinfusion , patients receive chemotherapy to deplete their own immune cells which are ineffective against the melanoma.

sentences.en: Conclusions Reinfusion of autologous shed blood is a safe and effective to decrease the use of allogenic blood and avoid the complications of its transfusion.
